name: Shackleton Rim (Point A)
source_note: "Point A" on the rim of Shackleton crater, 89.68 S 166.0 W, from Bussey et al. (2010), Icarus 208, 558-564, illumination of the south pole from Kaguya topography.
selection: best-lit point with slope <= 8 deg within 1 km of the reference (474 m away; 36.63% -> 56.55% sunlight in 2027 at 2 m)
dem_source: PGDA 81 LOLA 5 m/px (87S) to 7.5 km + PGDA 90 LOLA 20 m/px (80S) to 60 km + PGDA 90 LOLA 240 m/px (60S) to 200 km

name: Mons Mouton (IM-2 Athena site)
source_note: Resting position of Intuitive Machines' IM-2 Athena lander (landed 2025-03-06), located by LROC at 84.7906 S 29.1957 E inside a ~20 m crater. Mons Mouton is also the VIPER target area and a NASA Artemis III candidate region (2024 list); this point is the Athena site, not the summit of the massif.
dem_source: PGDA 90 LOLA 10 m/px (83S) to 7.5 km + PGDA 90 LOLA 20 m/px (80S) to 60 km + PGDA 90 LOLA 240 m/px (60S) to 200 km
